# CatchThePrice

> Price comparison, price tracking, deals discovery and shopping intelligence
> for shoppers in the UAE and United States. Smarter Shopping for a Brighter Tomorrow.

CatchThePrice compares prices across authorized retailers (including Amazon UAE and Noon),
tracks price history, surfaces real price drops and deals, and lets shoppers save products
and create price-drop alerts. All published prices come from verified production sources;
unverified or stale observations are never shown as live prices.

## Markets

- UAE: https://catchtheprice.com/ae
- United States: https://catchtheprice.com/us

## Key public pages

- Homepage (per market): https://catchtheprice.com/ae
- All deals: https://catchtheprice.com/ae/deals/all
- Price drops: https://catchtheprice.com/ae/price-drops/all
- Categories: https://catchtheprice.com/ae/category/{slug} (e.g. smartphones, laptops, headphones)
- Brands: https://catchtheprice.com/ae/brand/{slug}
- Retailers: https://catchtheprice.com/ae/retailer/{slug}
- Product pages: https://catchtheprice.com/ae/product/{slug}
- Buying guides and articles: https://catchtheprice.com/ae/blog and https://catchtheprice.com/ae/blog/{slug}
- Price comparison tool: https://catchtheprice.com/ae/compare

## Data and crawling notes

- Sitemap: https://catchtheprice.com/sitemap.xml
- Outbound retailer links are affiliate links (rel="sponsored noopener"); they open in a new tab.
- Search results pages (/search) and account pages are intentionally not indexed.
- Admin areas (/admin, /admin-access) are private and excluded from indexing.
- Analytics: optional Google Analytics 4 (IP anonymization on) only after visitor consent;
  a first-party analytics preference with the same consent gate is offered in the privacy banner.
- Affiliate disclosure: https://catchtheprice.com/affiliate-disclosure
